Tom Whitaker.description: conversing about Tom Whitaker and Marcus Williams discussing concerns about the datacenter proposal, gathering community feedback, and planning to strengthen their case for transparency at the upcoming town hall meeting. @ <persona> Marcus Williams
chat: Tom Whitaker

Hey Marcus, I see you're getting ready for the meetings. I've been thinking a lot about the datacenter proposal and how rushed the whole process seems. I agree with you on that. Have you gathered any new feedback from the community that we can use to strengthen our case?
Marcus Williams

Hey Tom, glad to hear you're on board with us. Yes, I've been collecting feedback, and the community is very concerned about the lack of transparency and the potential impact on local resources. I'm compiling all the points, and we should definitely bring these up at the town hall meeting. It'd be great if you could join us there and share your thoughts as well.
Tom Whitaker

Absolutely, Marcus. I'll be there for sure. I'll also talk to Denise and see if we can bring more neighbors along. The more voices we have, the stronger our case will be. Let's keep pushing for more transparency.
Marcus Williams

Thanks, Tom. I really appreciate your support and effort in rallying more neighbors. I'll make sure to send you and Denise the handouts and talking points for the town hall meeting later today. Let's make sure everyone is prepared and knows what to expect. Looking forward to seeing you there!
Tom Whitaker

Great, Marcus. I'll make sure to distribute the handouts and talking points to the neighbors I talk to. Let's aim to have a strong presence at the town hall. Thanks again for organizing everything. I'll catch up with you later today if there's anything else we need to address.
